shortDescription: Manage the state of virtual host limits in RabbitMQ

options.name: max_connections
options.description: Max number of concurrent client connections. Negative value means "no limit". Ignored when the I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: max_queues
options.description: Max number of queues. Negative value means "no limit". Ignored when the I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: node
options.description: Name of the RabbitMQ Erlang node to manage.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify whether the limits are to be set or cleared. If set to C(absent), the limits of both I(max_connections) and I(max-queues) will be cleared.

options.name: vhost
options.description: Name of the virtual host to manage.
